cases.name: Erin Gatier
cases.about: She was a Market Executive for Compassus Home Health in Willingboro. Gina Long, the company's director of communications, released the following statement: "Our Compassus team mourns the devastating loss of a beloved colleague, leader and friend. Erin was a trusted and respected leader with a heart for hospice who will be deeply missed..."
